scope_rule: Original broader task text is history. Current proposed request/candidate texts are evaluated only within the frozen finite input set; no whole-API implementation or general contract proof follows.

requests.request_text: Parse ASCII integers with optional sign and no whitespace; allow ungrouped digits or comma groups of one to three initial digits followed by exactly three; zero on grammar or overflow errors.
requests.original_request_history: Add ParseCommaStrict accepting ungrouped integers or canonical three-digit comma groups and rejecting malformed grouping.

candidates.text: Use the original comma parser, removing all commas before checked integer parsing.
Check signed ASCII comma groups first, parse an int64, and return zero for grammar or range errors.
Call the original comma parser directly and retain its permissive grouping behavior.

requests.request_text: For the Name string field with case insensitive matching, reject every multiple matching key before assignment, including equal values or exact spelling; return sorted conflicting keys.
requests.original_request_history: Add an opt-in ambiguity error when multiple input keys match one destination field through MatchName; do not resolve the conflict by random map order.

candidates.text: Decode Name with original case insensitive matching; preserve exact key lookup and fallback selection.
Sort every matching Name key; reject collisions before writing; otherwise use the original decoder.

requests.request_text: Return an independent snapshot of string to string flag maps; preserve nil and missing flag errors and the legacy shared getter. Mutations must not cross snapshot and live maps.
requests.original_request_history: Add a snapshot getter for string-to-string flags that returns an independent map while preserving the existing documented shared-map getter.

candidates.text: Return the legacy getter map and preserve its shared storage.

requests.request_text: Parse nonnegative ASCII decimal sizes using existing byte units exactly; preserve whole numbers, reject uint64 overflow before truncating fractions, and return zero on error.
requests.original_request_history: Make ParseBytes evaluate fractional decimal sizes with exact arithmetic, checking the uint64 range before truncating toward zero.

candidates.text: Call original ParseBytes: checked integer arithmetic for whole numbers and float64 multiplication for decimals.
Evaluate decimal scaling exactly; check the rational uint64 range before truncating; delegate whole numbers to the original parser.
Compute decimals exactly but truncate before testing the uint64 range.

limitations: Comma candidates 0/2 share one original implementation; different captions do not create independent parents or implementations.
Collision scope is only one Name string field; a full DecoderConfig option is not implemented or evaluated.
Snapshot sharing is specific to the exact pflag revision; other revisions were not executed.
Five byte cases are decimal ASCII inputs using B/KiB; whole delegation is source-reviewed only. General units/grammar/Unicode regression is not established.
No IDs, source references, Want/Got, outcomes, counters, roles, groups, weights or hashes may become model features. Only separately qualified request/candidate texts are eligible.
